stories.title: Jury deadlocked as Clancy defense battles holdout juror
new_facts: Jury deadlock tied to a holdout-juror dispute; deliberations set to resume Friday.
Secret message found on Clancy's wheelchair; legal expert warns of 'enormous risk.'
Jury has deliberated over 35 hours after five weeks of testimony.
Defense lawyer formally asks judge to remove a holdout juror; deliberations enter a seventh day.
Judge declines defense's request to remove the holdout juror.
Defense reveals a note singling out a juror for 'not following the law' on another deadlock day.
Foreperson's note says holdout juror isn't following reasonable-doubt instructions; jury composed of 9 women, 3 men.
New story: Lindsay Clancy, MA mother who killed her three young children in Jan 2023, trial jury deadlocked twice, day 6 deliberations.
stories.line: Jury deadlocked in Lindsay Clancy murder trial; defense seeks removal of one holdout juror.

stories.title: Genetically modified pig kidney sustains patient for record nine months
new_facts: Establishes story: pig kidneys successfully transplanted into humans in a US trial
Names patient Tim Andrews, 67, of New Hampshire; lived 9 months with pig kidney before human transplant
Gives precise record duration of 271 days for functioning pig kidney
Names the pig 'Wilma', gives odds (9% vs 40%) of receiving human kidney, cites type 2 diabetes as cause
Specifies transplant date as January 2025
stories.line: A genetically modified pig kidney sustained a transplant patient for nine months until a human kidney became available, demonstrating xenotransplantation viability.

stories.title: Tesla begins offering rides in steering-wheel-free Cybercab
new_facts: Tesla's Cybercab held an invite-only debut in Austin, keeping online fans waiting for hours.
Cybercab rides now available in limited Austin areas; 45 Cybercabs registered in Texas, no steering wheel/pedals.
Tesla published a website form soliciting interest in buying and operating Cybercab fleets.
stories.line: Tesla is offering rides in a fully autonomous vehicle without steering wheel or pedals, betting consumers will trust the technology.

stories.title: Gloria Steinem, feminist pioneer, dies at 92
new_facts: Contrarian op-ed questioning Steinem's legacy, challenging uncritical media coverage.
Steinem's own posthumous final essay published in The New Yorker with new quote.
Kamala Harris and Oprah Winfrey added to list of public figures paying tribute.
Adds new tribute-givers: Meghan Markle and Lena Dunham.
stories.line: Gloria Steinem, feminist activist and co-founder of Ms. Magazine, has died at 92.

stories.title: Argentina threatens sanctions on Falklands oil operations
new_facts: Argentina's Milei escalates Falklands sovereignty claim, linked to oil drilling dispute and UK-US tensions
Argentina's Milei threatens sanctions on companies drilling for oil off the Falklands
Milei says oil firms working off Falklands face sanctions, cites 'winds of change' favouring Argentina's claim
Milei vows sanctions on offshore drilling firms, calling islands 'our future' under 'British occupation'
stories.line: Argentina's president threatens sanctions against oil companies operating near the Falklands, restating territorial claims that Britain contests.

stories.title: Trump names engineering official as acting Army secretary
new_facts: Trump names Adam Telle as new acting Army secretary after Driscoll's resignation.
Adds Telle's current role: assistant secretary of the Army for civil works.
Adds Telle's biography: served as Trump's first-term special assistant for legislative affairs.
Specifies Driscoll's clash with Hegseth was over the purge of top Army generals.
stories.line: Trump replaces the Army secretary after a departure, naming an engineering official to the interim role.

stories.title: Prosecutor fired while investigating ICE shooting; officer charged with lying
new_facts: A federal prosecutor investigating the ICE officer for civil rights crimes was fired, sources say.
ICE officer who shot the Venezuelan immigrant is now in federal custody after being charged with false statements.
Charges say the shooting fuelled an uprising in Minnesota earlier this year.
stories.line: A federal prosecutor investigating an ICE officer's shooting of a Venezuelan immigrant was fired; the officer now faces charges for lying about the incident.

stories.title: Russia deploys Cold War tanks as Ukraine, U.S., and Putin signal peace talks
new_facts: US negotiators to visit Kyiv and Moscow soon to resume peace talks, per Zelenskyy; Trump says he wants war to end.
stories.line: Russia deploys aging tanks as both sides signal willingness to pursue peace talks, with U.S. envoy expected in Kyiv.

stories.title: South Korea prepares military deployment to Strait of Hormuz
new_facts: Iran struck US military targets in Gulf in retaliation for a wedding attack that killed four; South Korea weighs Hormuz deployment.
South Korea aims to dispatch Hormuz-bound military assets before year's end, per government/military sources.
stories.line: South Korea is preparing to deploy military forces to the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping chokepoint.
